ak_bootybay: Vexa Coppercount, Artifact Keeper. Yes, a goblin who does not charge - look at it while it lasts. My stall is in the middle of the Bay, above the vault. The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. Keepers do not sell. It hurts me to say it every time.
bootybay_lookout: Minzi, lookout. I have the top of the stair at the north end of Booty Bay, where the jungle road comes in. Clear to the cape. Which only means I cannot see them yet.
bootybay_gate_guard: Kolk. Bruiser, north gate - the only way into the Bay that is not a boat. Trouble on the quay is my trouble. Trouble up here, on the jungle side, is yours.
bootybay_toll_collector: Nizzik, tollkeeper. My window is at the east end of the upper quay, where the Ratchet boat ties up. Landing fee. You have already landed, so we are only arguing about the amount.
bootybay_cartel_factor: Weezel, factor for the Steamwheedle Cartel. My office is on the west side of the Bay. The port has not left the company. I have the paperwork. Nobody reads it, least of all the Baron.
bootybay_street_kid: Scrip. I work the upper quay, all of it. Carry your crate? Watch your crate? Both is cheaper. I also know where things are, and that costs extra.
bootybay_crane_hand: Durgo, crane-hand. That is the Bay's one crane, on the east quay, and I am the one who swings it. Stand under it once and you will not do it twice.
bootybay_harbourmaster: Sprocket, harbourmaster. The tower at the east end of the quay is mine. Tide, berth, weather, and who is lying about which. That is the whole tower, and the tower is the whole port.
bootybay_flight_master: Zekki, wind-rider. De roost be in de middle of de upper quay. North to de camp at Grom'gol, and dat is de whole map. Nobody flies out of dis jungle - you want out, you take de boat.
bootybay_vaultkeep: Girzzik Vaultkeep. The bank is on the west side of the Bay, cut down into the rock. The vault is under the waterline and it has never flooded. Think about that before you ask me whether your things are safe.
bootybay_dockmaster: Brek, dockmaster. I run the piers on the east side, below the crane. Three piers, one crane, and everybody wants the middle one.
bootybay_fence: They call me the Quiet Man. I stand at the west end of the lower quay, where the lamps do not reach. I did not see you come in and I will not see you leave. In between, I buy things.
bootybay_troll_pilot: Zan'rek, pilot. I bring de boats in past de reef from de east side of de Bay. De reef moves. Not fast. Fast enough. Every captain who did not pay for a pilot is part of it now.
bootybay_shipwright: Vella, shipwright. The slip is at the south-west corner of the Bay. Salt, worm and rot. Pick two and I can still float it. All three, and I can sell you the nails back.
bootybay_bloodsail_captive: Oona. Dagger-hand, off a Bloodsail deck. They keep me at the south end of the Bay, in sight of the Baron. They have not hanged me and they have not let me go. I think the Baron is waiting to see what I am worth to my old crew.
bootybay_baron_aide: Fipple, aide to the Baron. His table is at the south end of the Bay and I am the door to it. The Baron is reviewing it. The Baron is always reviewing it.
bootybay_baron: Baron Revilgaz. Booty Bay is mine - the quay, the cove, and the water as far as you can see from this table. Nothing leaves this cove without my name on it. Not even you. Three years ago the sea changed its mind about a few things, and I have been charging for the difference ever since.
